versions.content: Provide information on supported microcontroller and used tool chain If the BSW Module implementation depends on microcontroller, then the BSW Module documentation shall also contain the following information: • Microcontroller vendor • Microcontroller family • Microcontroller derivative • Microcontroller stepping (mask revision), if relevant • Tool chain name and version • Tool chain options which were used for development / qualification of module
